parameters.name: LocalIPAddress
parameters.description: The local IPv4 address for this connection received via IPCP.

parameters.name: RemoteIPAddress
parameters.description: The remote IPv4 address for this connection received via IPCP.

parameters.name: DNSServers
parameters.description: {{list}} Items represent DNS Server IPv4 address(es) received via IPCP {{bibref|RFC1877}}.

parameters.name: PassthroughEnable
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the PPP Interface retrieved information is configured on the IP Interface stacked on top of this PPP Interface. If {{true}}, the PPP Interface retrieved information is propagated to the parameters in the referenced {{param|PassthroughDHCPPool}} object, replacing any existing configuration (including ''MinAddress'', ''MaxAddress'', ''SubnetMask'', ''IPRouters'', and ''DNSServers'').

parameters.name: PassthroughDHCPPool
parameters.description: {{reference}}When {{param}} is set to {{empty}}, {{param|PassthroughEnable}} MUST be set to {{false}} (i.e. passthrough can not be enabled without a pool reference specified).

object.description: IP Control Protocol (IPCP) client object for this PPP interface {{bibref|RFC1332}}. {{object}} only applies to IPv4.
